title: Tenma Saki — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, Tsukasa and my dad began bawling their eyes out as they ate what I made...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that's the Tenma household for you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Morning, everyone!!!
Good wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someone's full of energy this morning...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hearing Emu say “good wonderhoy” gives everyone that boost of energy they need in the morning!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A boost of energy?
She sounds more like an alarm clock to me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Morning, Saki, Shiho!
Good wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What were you two talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I was just telling Shiho about what happened during dinner last night at my house.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dinner?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My mom was gone for the evening and I had a little time on my hands, so I decided to make dinner for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My little sister...who used to be so small... Now she's making fabulous feasts for us... I-I-I'm overcome with joy...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He suddenly started crying about that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that's so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And it wasn't just Tsukasa.
Your dad also started crying uncontrollably, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I dunno what came over them. It's not like it was the first time I made dinner for them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It must've been their way of expressing how happy they were!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish I could eat something you made too, Saki! Oh, what did you make for them?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Spaghetti with meat sauce!
It was super simple, so it was really nothing special...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, what did you two have last night?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Japanese dishes as always.
Braised fish, pickles, miso soup and such.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that totally suits your house too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, at my house!
We had something that sizzled and popped like crazy! And one spoonful made you want to run in circles!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something that sizzled and popped...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! You had curry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ding ding ding♪
You got it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, we also had those things!
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
I can't remember what they're called!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, what were they called?!
They're fluffy and gooey and stretch like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fluffy, gooey and stretchy...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What about mochi? They're gooey...
But I guess they don't really go with curry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... I still don't know...
Can you give us more hints, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
More hints...?
When did this turn into a quiz?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, umm...
You eat it by tearing it and dipping it in the curry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You tear it and dip it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! Naan!
And I bet it had cheese inside!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it!
How did you know, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll give it to you that your last hint was pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, Saki, how did you know it had cheese inside?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because she said it was gooey and stretchy! That screamed cheese to me♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
I never would've thought of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But not many people make naan at home! I really wanna try what you had now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, you guys should come over to my house sometime for a naan party! We can have lots and lots of it together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
We can eat while chatting about stuff!
It's gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, we should call it the great “We're In The Same Class! Let's Celebrate!” naan bake off!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, does that include me as well...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course it does!
We're in the same class, aren't we?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll make lots and lots of naan for you, Shiho☆ We're gonna have cheese naan, chocolate naan, naan with whipped cream and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm good with just regular naan.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. A dinner party for just us three. I can't wait!
